assessment.checkpoint_sequence: CP1 Baseline -> CP2 Verified Implementation -> CP3 Evidence Snapshot -> CP4 Closure is coherent.
assessment.trigger_clarity: Candidate lists required eligibility and HOLD behavior; promotion needs a separate normative proposal.
assessment.scope: Scope-limited checkpoint files and approved state/evidence are required; unrelated files are excluded.
assessment.validation_before_promotion: Required validators and evidence linkage must PASS before checkpoint creation.
assessment.git_delivery: Fast-forward only; remote divergence causes HOLD.
assessment.duplicate_no_change: Materially identical CP2/CP3/CP4 must not create duplicate commits.
assessment.recovery_vs_rollback: Recovery preserves facts; rollback must not erase Runtime Evidence, external side effects, approval changes, or SSOT conflicts.
assessment.side_effect_preservation: Actual Runtime and side-effect history remain immutable reference facts.
assessment.approval_requirements: Activation and any global Rule promotion require a separate review and explicit User approval gate.
assessment.cost_storage: JSON records and Git snapshots are small, but repeated Evidence snapshots can accumulate and require an explicit retention decision before activation.

promotion.recommended_next_step: Separate Checkpoint Policy Rule Promotion Proposal and User approval decision.
